### Dataset name and source

Link to a dataset landing page, DOI or publication. Include the version if available.

### Task and measurements

Describe the molecular system, assay, measured outcome and units. For mutation data, include the reference and variant notation.

### Access and license

Link to the terms of use and describe how to obtain the data.

### Benchmark fit

What would this dataset help evaluate?
